findings.issue: «a él» can be read as a personal direct object; לו is a preposition plus a 3ms suffix (to/for him), and the object marker is a later token.
The definite article «las» is grammatical smoothing; the absolute plural has no article.
«en» selects the locative of ב; the preposition also licenses instrumental with/by, and the 3mp suffix does not decide.

notes: Counts, qal stems, 3ms suffixes, and both side-phrases match the tokens.
